title: Compensation Basis for a Late Recovery Review (Harborline Customer Accounts)
content:
# Compensation basis of the late-review goodwill

> Harborline Customer Accounts

The compensation basis of the late-review goodwill depends on how late the review was, counted in the days the review was late (the calendar days the review took, from submission date to decision date, less 7):

| Days the review was late | Compensation basis of the late-review goodwill figure |
|---|---|
| 7 or more | $8.00 for each started week of those days |
| 2 or more but fewer than 7 | $8.00 flat |
| fewer than 2 | $2.00 for each of those days |

A started week counts in full, so 7 late days are one started week and 9 late days are two.

**Hypothetical reading.** 1 late day: $2.00. 2 late days: $8.00. 6 late days: $8.00. 7 late days: $8.00. 9 late days: $16.00.
